budget.on_exhaustion: keep partial checkpoints/losses; skip heldout; no reduced-threshold substitute

development.role: progress diagnostics only; no tuning or model selection
development.witness_policy: first learned reset in a command-to-first-query window; counterfactual memory/validity perturbation, same context; explicitly not a quality score

heldout_policy: Only construct after all four fits complete. One quality forward per model/panel; derive all scores and raw arrays from it. Mapped identity and replay audit are separately labeled verification.

additional_conditions_for_registered_gap: all four fits complete and pass every quality panel
zero UNKNOWN false accepts across both reset panels, for every fit
every visible RESET-to-first-query window contains a learned reset event
a model-produced development event passes exact counterfactual erasure witness
mechanism_claim.claim_scope: bounded registered command-reset experiment only; not all P2, autonomous resets, arbitrary inputs, or HCSN superiority

model.known_probability: sigmoid(12*(validity_dot_address-0.5)); multiply learned four-way value probabilities
model.mapped_put_linear: same canonical parameters; exact arithmetic identity only. FP32 rounding can cross a hard threshold: retain counterexample and measure actual event equality and log-probability error per trained checkpoint.

numeric_contract.conditional_exact_erasure: when a finite learned reset event is computed and forward returns, memory/validity/older are exactly zero and previous=current; pre-erasure avoids the reviewed huge-finite-state overflow
numeric_contract.nonfinite_events_outputs_or_state: fail closed with ArithmeticError; no quality certificate

model.reset_priority: pre-erase memory/validity/address context by keep before normalize/bmm/dot; active_write=keep*write; older=keep*previous; previous=current observed embedding
model.straight_through: hard forward plus sigmoid derivative; no semantic event labels
model.validity: same learned address and write event; target value 1 for every learned write, not an oracle write mask

blockers_addressed: erase old state before bmm/dot to prevent zero times infinity
preserve constructive FP32 mapped hard-threshold counterexample
pre_execution_review.new_straight_through_surrogate: pre-erase M/v/previous by keep; use active_write=keep*write; compute address and products from pre-erased state. This has the intended hard forward semantics but a changed relaxed surrogate, frozen before any fit.

rationale.chosen_intervention: Use neural hard write/reset events with sigmoid straight-through gradients, reset priority over writes and controller context, plus an independently updated binding-validity vector and factorized known/UNKNOWN probabilities.
rationale.not_claimed: The event detector can be wrong; continuous learned addresses can cross-talk. Conditional erasure is not semantic reset correctness or a global no-resurrection theorem.
rationale.prior_observation: Round2 learned associative memory: three successful fits failed repeated-reset sequence exactness; all their errors were false known answers on UNKNOWN queries. One HCSN seed failed broadly. No old heldout stream is reused.
rationale.soft_reset_counterexample: With no write and finite sigmoid reset r in (0,1), M_next=(1-r)*M is nonzero for nonzero M; exact erasure is not guaranteed.
rationale.soft_write_counterexample: For a repeated unit address and write probability w in (0,1), a scalar validity update tends to 1-(1-w)^N despite no intended write; merely adding a soft validity vector cannot prevent accumulation.

training.checkpoint: final fixed update only; no selection, seed filtering, retry, or schedule changes
training.loss: only query answer cross entropy; no event, key, or hidden-state auxiliary targets
